Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You offer a dropped cup, a pointed remark, or a sudden flourish at exactly the right moment.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One creature within 3 squares that can perceive your distraction
Duration
Until the start of your next turn or until the granted Boon is used.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Pay the printed action and any full activity time for each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Choose a creature within 3 squares that can see or hear your distraction. Describe what you do and roll Guile. The benefits below must be used before the start of your next turn; this does not automatically make an ally Hidden.

Weak
The next ally attempting to move past that creature unnoticed gains 1 Boon to that roll.
Standard
That ally may instead use the Boon on an attack against the distracted creature.
Strong
Two different allies may each use one of those benefits once.

Source: design/cards/create-a-distraction.md at bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809.
